title: [GMCP 203.025.02] Production path: OAuth-protected MCP resource server
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-025-02. Implement the canonical state, types, and primary production path. Replace stubs, demo-only paths, duplicated semantics, and implicit ambient state; preserve compatible behavior through explicit adapters; and make the new path reachable from the shipped GMCP runtime. Vector outcome: Remote GMCP endpoints implement current MCP authorization and OAuth resource-server requirements: protected-resource metadata, authorization-server discovery, issuer and audience validation, scopes, challenges, PKCE-facing metadata, token expiry/revocation and TLS. Token passthrough is impossible, resource and authorization roles remain separated, and confused-deputy, mix-up, replay and malformed-token suites fail closed. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
